_README: Single source of truth for business identity. Every value marked PLACEHOLDER must be replaced with verified real data before this site goes live. The server logs a startup warning and blocks production boot while placeholders remain (see src/config.js).
tagline: Factory and custom Glock pistols, slides and triggers
fflLicenceType: PLACEHOLDER (for example Type 01 Dealer in Firearms)

jurisdiction.country: PLACEHOLDER ISO country, for example US
jurisdiction.regulator: PLACEHOLDER primary firearms regulator for this jurisdiction
jurisdiction.notes: Ages above are the common United States federal baseline for a licensed dealer. They MUST be re-confirmed against the client's actual jurisdiction and state law before launch. If the business operates outside the United States these values and every policy page have to be rewritten for that country's law.

policy.transferProcessText: PLACEHOLDER. The client must supply the exact wording of their firearm transfer process, including which licence the firearm ships to, what identification and background check is required, who pays transfer fees, and which destinations are refused. Nothing about the transfer process may be invented by the developer.
policy.complianceReviewedBy: PLACEHOLDER name of the attorney or compliance officer who signed off
